title: Scopus Journal Manuscript Enhancement
brief: I have a completed research-article draft in the field of law / social sciences that now needs to be elevated to Scopus-indexed-journal standards. The core of the assignment is twofold: 1. Substantive development • Strengthen every argument, flag and fill logical or evidentiary gaps, and suggest — or implement, with my approval — re-structuring that improves flow and coherence. • Ensure that the literature review, methodology, findings, and discussion all align with current scholarship and clearly answer the paper’s research questions. • Provide concise, track-changed comments explaining each substantive revision so I can learn from and approve them. • Advise on journal selection, cover-letter wording, and response-to-reviewers strategy right through to final acceptance. 2. Language, style, and formatting • Full academic language polishing: grammar, tone, tense consistency, and terminology specific to law / social science discourse. • Sentence-level editing and paraphrasing where clarity or originality demands it, while safeguarding meaning and avoiding plagiarism flags. • Reference check against the target journal’s style guide; cross-verify every in-text citation, footnote, and entry in the reference list. • Apply final layout and heading hierarchy so the manuscript meets the template requirements of the chosen Scopus journal. Deliverables • A track-changed Word file plus a clean final version. • A brief editorial report summarising major changes, outstanding issues, and readiness level. • Journal-specific formatting and reference conformity sheet. • Ongoing guidance up to the point of successful submission (and, if needed, post-review revisions). Please include in your proposal: – An estimated turnaround time for the first full edited draft and subsequent revision cycles. – Your total project fee and any milestone breakdowns. – Confirmation that you have handled law / social-science articles destined for Scopus or similar indexed journals, citing examples if possible. Note-Only freelancers with substantial experience in publishing research papers in Scopus-indexed/Web of Science journals should submit their bids. Preference will be given to those with a proven publication record(Only in Scopus and WOS, particularly in the field of Law). I am ready to begin as soon as I select the right editor. Note: Only freelancers with substantial publication experience in Scopus-indexed or Web of Science (WoS)-indexed journals, particularly in Law, should bid. Verifiable proof of authored or co-authored publications (DOI, journal links, etc.) is mandatory. Bids without such evidence will not be considered.

title: Coordinador de seguridad e infraestructura - SOLO ECUADOR GYE -- 2
brief: Garantizar la confidencialidad, integridad y disponibilidad (CID) de la información de ICUBE y de sus clientes, liderando la implementación, soporte y mantenimiento del Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información (SGSI – ISO/IEC 27001: International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission), asegurando que la empresa cumpla con estándares internacionales y normativa nacional vigente. --- Funciones Clave 1. Implementar, mantener y mejorar el SGSI (Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información) en concordancia con ISO/IEC 27001. 2. Identificar y gestionar riesgos de seguridad, desarrollando el Mapa de Riesgos y planes de tratamiento. 3. Administrar y supervisar los controles de acceso, identidades y privilegios (IAM – Identity and Access Management / MFA – Multi-Factor Authentication). 4. Gestionar la detección, análisis y remediación de vulnerabilidades. 5. Implementar y monitorear soluciones de seguridad como: o EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) o SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) o DLP (Data Loss Prevention) o SOC (Security Operations Center) 6. Definir y aplicar baselines (líneas base de configuración segura) y hardening (endurecimiento de sistemas). 7. Diseñar, ejecutar y validar planes de respaldo y recuperación (DRP – Disaster Recovery Plan / BCP – Business Continuity Plan). 8. Documentar procesos, procedimientos y políticas de seguridad. 9. Capacitar y concienciar a colaboradores en seguridad de la información. 10. Asegurar cumplimiento de la normativa nacional LOPDP (Ley Orgánica de Protección de Datos Personales – Ecuador). 11. Apoyar en auditorías internas y externas de seguridad y certificación. --- Formación Académica: · Ingeniero/a en Sistemas, Informática, Telecomunicaciones o carreras afines. Conocimientos requeridos · Gestión de riesgos y seguridad informática. · Normas: ISO/IEC 27001 (Seguridad de la Información), ISO 22301 (Continuidad del Negocio), LOPDP (Protección de Datos). · Seguridad en entornos cloud (AWS – Amazon Web Services, Azure, Google Cloud Platform). · Arquitectura de redes y firewalls. · Procesos de DRP (Disaster Recovery Plan) y BCP (Business Continuity Plan). · Monitoreo de eventos de seguridad (SIEM, EDR, SOC). Conocimientos complementarios: · Administración de sistemas operativos (Linux). · Virtualización (VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox). Plataformas · Plataformas en nube (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). · Redes y telecomunicaciones (routing, switching, firewalls). · Bases de datos (MySQL, Postgresql, NoSql). Certificaciones deseables · ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer o Auditor Interno. · CompTIA Security+ (Computing Technology Industry Association Security Plus). · CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional). · CISM (Certified Information Security Manager). · CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker). · ITIL Foundation (Information Technology Infrastructure Library – Gestión de Servicios de TI). Competencias Clave · Pensamiento analítico y gestión de riesgos. · Ética profesional y confidencialidad. · Comunicación efectiva con áreas técnicas y directivas. · Liderazgo en gestión del cambio cultural hacia la seguridad. · Capacidad de respuesta ágil ante incidentes. title: Automatic Test Tube Capper/Decapper
brief: I am building a fully automatic machine that can both screw caps onto test tubes and remove them again in one seamless cycle. The system must reliably handle only screw-on caps—no snap-on lids or rubber stoppers—across a wide range of tube sizes: diameters from 0.5 in up to 5 in and lengths from 1 in to 10 in. During decapping, each cap has to drop straight into an integrated hopper inside the enclosure so they stay available for the next capping pass; the machine should never discard or individually pair caps with specific tubes. What I need from you is a complete, production-ready solution that covers mechanical design, the capping/decapping torque mechanism, motion control, and operator-friendly software. Quick change-over or adjustable tooling for the stated size range is important, as are common laboratory considerations such as stainless-steel contact parts, easy cleaning, and splash protection. Deliverables • Detailed 3-D CAD files, assembly drawings, and BOM • Control architecture and PCB program (or comparable controller) • Fabrication or prototype guidance proving the design meets the size and hopper-handling requirements • Commissioning support and a brief operating manual explaining settings for the different tube diameters and lengths If you have proven experience with product development, I look forward to seeing how you would approach this project and a rough timeline you can commit to.

title: MongoDB-SQL Data Migration Specialist
brief: The core of this engagement is a full-scale data move between MongoDB and a relational stack (either standard SQL or Oracle). I already run both environments side-by-side; what I need now is an expert who can map, transform, and transfer large, business-critical datasets without downtime or data loss. Your day-to-day will revolve around: • Designing a repeatable migration workflow that handles schema differences, nested documents, and referential integrity. • Building scripts or using native tools (mongoexport/mongoimport, mongodump, Oracle GoldenGate, SQL*Loader—whatever you are most efficient with) to execute the move. • Validating record counts, constraints, and performance on the target side so reporting and downstream apps see no surprises. Sector knowledge matters. Much of the source data is telecom customer and usage history, while the destination system also houses financial-style tables for invoicing and compliance. Prior exposure to either telco billing structures or financial transaction models will help you anticipate edge cases and design smarter transformations. When you reply, focus on concrete experience: the volumes you have moved, the toolchains you prefer, and any tricky migration challenges you have already solved between MongoDB and SQL/Oracle. Screenshots, brief metrics, or a short narrative of a past migration win will stand out more than a long proposal. Deliverable is a cleanly migrated, fully verified dataset in the relational store, along with the scripts or procedures I can reuse for future loads.

title: UK Business Development Manager – B2B Sales, Partnership Negotiation & Healthcare Service Launch
brief: About Mobile Midwives CIC Mobile Midwives CIC is a UK-based, midwife-led community interest company established to improve access to professional midwifery information, education and support outside traditional healthcare pathways. Due to the nature of this project and our target market, we have a strong preference for a UK-based freelancer with experience of UK business development and commercial relationship management. The successful candidate will be expected to personally conduct telephone conversations, virtual meetings and commercial negotiations with UK healthcare business owners. This is a relationship-led business development role, rather than an outsourced digital marketing or lead generation project. We are an ambitious, developing organisation with an established infrastructure, qualified midwives, booking systems, branding and a wider strategic development plan. We are now looking to move from development into active service promotion and sustainable income generation. About the project We are seeking a confident, commercially minded freelance business development professional to take ownership of the launch and growth of our remote midwifery support service, known as the Mobile Midwives Helpline. The service enables families to book telephone or online conversations with registered midwives, providing accessible, personalised information, education, reassurance and signposting throughout their pregnancy journey. Our initial target market is independent pregnancy ultrasound and scanning clinics across the UK. We believe there is a significant opportunity to establish mutually beneficial partnerships with these clinics, enabling them to offer their customers access to additional professional midwifery support following their scans. We have identified the opportunity and developed the service. We now require someone with the commercial confidence, initiative and business development experience to turn this opportunity into active partnerships, referrals and paying customers. Project objectives The successful freelancer will work alongside the founder and existing team to: Review the existing service offering and understand its commercial potential. Establish a clear launch date and develop a realistic implementation plan. Identify and research suitable independent pregnancy scanning clinics across the UK. Develop a compelling business-to-business partnership proposition. Identify and establish contact with clinic owners, managers and key decision-makers. Proactively approach prospective partners through telephone calls, emails and meetings. Confidently present the benefits of working with Mobile Midwives. Explore and negotiate mutually beneficial commercial and referral arrangements within agreed parameters. Secure opportunities for clinics to display Mobile Midwives promotional posters and distribute information to their customers. Coordinate the development of appropriate promotional and partnership materials with our existing team. Establish a system for recording prospective partners, communications, agreed arrangements and follow-up actions. Coordinate the commercial launch of the service. Monitor referrals, bookings, income and the effectiveness of established partnerships. What we already have This is not a project requiring someone to build a business from scratch. We already have: An established UK community interest company. A defined service offering. Registered midwives. Online booking and appointment infrastructure. An existing brand and website. An established pricing and practitioner remuneration model. A wider organisational development strategy. Clinical expertise and administrative support. The focus of this project is commercial implementation, partnership development and customer acquisition. Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is: Commercially confident and entrepreneurial. An excellent verbal and written communicator. Comfortable initiating conversations with business owners and senior decision-makers. Skilled in negotiation and relationship development. Proactive, resourceful and able to work independently. Comfortable working within a developing organisation. Able to identify opportunities and turn them into practical outcomes. Organised and accountable for agreed deliverables. Confident making recommendations and constructively challenging existing ideas where appropriate. Focused on generating measurable commercial results. Experience in business development, B2B sales, commercial partnerships, service launches or working with start-ups and small businesses would be particularly valuable. Experience within UK healthcare, private healthcare, maternity services or related industries would be advantageous but is not essential. Clinical knowledge and guidance will be provided by our existing team. An understanding of UK business culture and availability to communicate with prospective partners during UK business hours are important. Working arrangements This is initially a freelance, project-based opportunity with predominantly remote working and flexible hours. We would like to agree a defined initial project scope, budget, milestones and deliverables with the successful candidate. As a developing community interest company, we are mindful of expenditure and are looking for someone who understands the importance of achieving a measurable return on investment. Our longer-term ambition is to establish a dedicated commercial and business development function within Mobile Midwives. Whilst this initial project is focused on the launch and growth of our Helpline service, we see the potential for the successful candidate to take on a broader, ongoing role within the organisation, subject to demonstrated results, revenue generation and sustainable business growth. The role does not involve providing clinical advice or accessing patient records. Commercial activity must remain within agreed professional, ethical and regulatory boundaries. What success looks like We are not simply looking for a written business development strategy or a list of potential contacts. We want someone who can actively implement the strategy, establish meaningful business relationships and help convert those relationships into sustainable income. Success will be measured through agreed indicators, including: Development and implementation of a clear launch plan. Engagement with relevant clinic decision-makers. Established clinic partnerships. Distribution of promotional materials. Customer referrals and bookings. Revenue generated. Recommendations for continued growth and expansion. When applying Please include: A brief introduction and overview of your relevant experience. Examples of previous projects where you have helped a business launch a service, establish commercial partnerships or generate new income. How you would approach this particular project. Your experience of approaching and negotiating with business owners. Your availability and proposed fee structure. What you believe could realistically be achieved within the first four to six weeks. We welcome applications from individuals who are excited by the opportunity to help develop an innovative, socially responsible healthcare organisation and contribute to its long-term commercial sustainability.

title: Redesign Project Brief Form
brief: I’m looking to refine the single screen where users write their project description so that it guides them to produce a thorough, well-structured brief without feeling overwhelmed. Right now the page shows a large text box, a short note about the 91 million-strong talent pool and typical budget range (₹100 and up), plus a pink “Next” button that moves them on to skills, budget and payment. What’s missing is the coaching—users often freeze or drop in one-line requests. The goal is a cleaner, smarter layout that actively nudges them to include scope, required skills, deliverables and a timeline before they press Next. Micro-copy, dynamic placeholders, character or section progress indicators, or even inline examples are all welcome ideas if they remove friction and encourage richer briefs. I don’t need the entire posting flow redesigned right now; only this description form. There’s no hard deadline, so take the time to explore solid UX approaches and iterate until we land on something intuitive. Deliverables: • Wireframe variations for mobile and desktop breakpoints • High-fidelity prototype in Figma (or Sketch/Adobe XD if you prefer) ready for stakeholder review • Brief style guide covering typography, colours and micro-copy tone • Exportable assets and a hand-off link with organised layers and components I’ll test internally against completion rates and description length; success means more users submitting detailed briefs on the first try. Ready to craft a form that makes great project briefs the default?

title: UK Independent Car Dealer Email List -1000 emails
brief: We are looking for a reliable freelancer to collect business email addresses from UK car dealerships listed on Auto Trader. Source website: https://www.autotrader.co.uk/cars/dealers Your task is to go through the dealership listings, visit their individual business websites and collect their publicly available business email addresses. Requirements Business email address. Dealership website URL. No duplicate, invalid or guessed email addresses. Important – Collection Process Emails must be collected in sequential order, page by page and dealership by dealership. Start from the agreed page number. Work through every dealership in order before moving to the next page. Do not skip or randomly jump between pages. If a dealership does not have a publicly available email address, move to the next dealership. At the end of each working session, record the page number and the name of the last dealership you checked. Following this process is essential so that we know exactly where you stopped, allowing you or another freelancer to continue from the same point without repeating work or collecting duplicate emails. Payment $40 USD per 1,000 valid and unique email addresses. Payment is based on the number of valid emails collected, not the number of hours worked. Ongoing Opportunity This is a long-term opportunity for the right freelancer, with potentially thousands of email addresses to collect. When applying, please confirm that you understand and agree to follow the collection process outlined above.

title: Natural Candid Wedding Photo & Video
brief: I want the story of my wedding captured in a genuine, unobtrusive way so the finished images and footage feel like we are reliving the day, not reenacting it. We need a reliable freelancer who can publish job advertisements through their own legitimate Indeed Employer Account and support our high-volume recruitment campaign. Project Objective Our overall recruitment campaign aims to generate approximately 5,000 genuine applicants through Indeed job advertisements. We are looking for someone who can publish and manage job postings effectively to help us achieve this applicant target. Requirements Must have an active Indeed Employer/Recruiter Account. Minimum $10/Day in Indeed advertising spending history or established account standing. Previous experience publishing jobs on Indeed. Account must be in good standing and capable of publishing job advertisements. Experience managing multiple job postings. Ability to support high-volume recruitment campaigns. Scope of Work Publish job advertisements using your Indeed Employer Account. Follow our provided job descriptions and posting requirements. Ensure job advertisements are submitted accurately. Monitor job posting status and publication. Share job posting links and confirmation screenshots. Monitor applicant activity and provide regular updates. Support the overall target of generating approximately 5,000 genuine applicants. Applicant Quality Requirements Applicants must be genuine individuals who voluntarily apply for advertised positions. No fake, bot-generated or duplicate applications. Applications must come through Indeed's standard application process. Applicant volume and progress should be reported regularly. Payment $100 per successfully published, verified job post and share 5k applicants . Payment will be processed through Freelancer.com. Payment will be released after successful publication, verification and share 5k applicants. This is a per-job-post payment arrangement, not a payment-per-applicant arrangement. How to Apply Please answer the following questions: Do you currently have an active Indeed Employer Account? How long have you been using your Indeed account? What is your approximate Indeed advertising spending history? How many job postings have you successfully published? Have you previously managed high-volume applicant campaigns? Can you provide screenshots demonstrating your account status and previous job postings? Important We are specifically looking for freelancers who already own and operate their Indeed Employer Accounts. We are not looking for account creation services, account rentals or account-sharing arrangements. We are interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with reliable Indeed Job Posting Specialists who can support our recruitment requirements.

title: Baby Kindness Bedtime Story
brief: I need a warm, soothing bedtime tale for little listeners aged 0–3 that gently shows the joy of being kind and sharing. The language must be simple, rhythmic, and calming enough to settle toddlers while still holding their attention. Aim for a concise arc—beginning, middle, and end—wrapped up in roughly 350-500 words so it can be read in one sitting. Please weave the lesson organically into the narrative rather than spelling it out overtly; think soft repetition, comforting imagery, and age-appropriate dialogue. I’m happy to collaborate on character names or settings if you have ideas that suit this age range. Deliverables • Word or Google Doc containing the full story text • One round of light revisions after I review the draft If you’ve written board-book style stories or lullaby-like prose before, I’d love to see a sample. Let’s create something parents will enjoy reading as much as toddlers enjoy hearing.

title: SEO Blog Content Creator Needed
brief: My goal is to publish a steady stream of blog posts that rank well and pull fresh, top-of-funnel traffic from search engines. Every article will introduce newcomers to our industry, highlight the services we offer, and gently guide readers toward deeper engagement without a hard sell. Here’s how I see the workflow: • I’ll share an initial list of service-focused topics and seed keywords. • You’ll expand that list with supporting long-tail keywords and search intent insights drawn from tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Google Keyword Planner. • Each post should be clearly structured (H1–H3, short paragraphs, internal links), written in friendly, jargon-free language, and optimized for on-page SEO best practices. Deliverables for each approved topic: - 1 polished article (roughly 1,000–1,200 words; final length confirmed together) - Compelling meta title and meta description - 3–5 suggested royalty-free images with attribution - A brief keyword report showing primary and secondary terms used I’ll review every draft, provide quick feedback, and green-light the final version for publishing on our CMS. If this first batch goes well, there’s plenty more content to come—consistency is key to the traffic gains we’re targeting.

title: WeChat Reactivation Verification Assistance
brief: My personal WeChat has been locked after a long period of inactivity. To unlock it, WeChat is asking me to “Ask a WeChat friend to confirm your account details.” Here is what that means for you: • Your account must be at least six months old and, according to the prompt, must not have helped anyone else verify recently. • When you tap the on-screen request, WeChat will ask you to confirm my WeChat ID or account name—nothing more. You will never need my password or any sensitive data. • Once the confirmation succeeds and I regain access, I will release the fixed-price payment immediately. I will share a screenshot of the exact prompt so you can see the steps in advance, and I’ll stay online while we do the process so communication is instant. If you meet the two requirements above and are willing to help, let me know a convenient time and your experience with similar WeChat verifications.

title: Build Global Professional Network
brief: I want to launch an international professional-networking platform that can comfortably scale past 91 million members. The core experience I need you to deliver is straightforward: users must be able to create rich profiles, connect with other professionals, send private messages, and participate in interest-based groups. Finding the right people quickly is essential, so the site has to offer fast, intuitive search by name, job title, or company. Clean UX, accurate indexing, and smart autocomplete will be key here. Everything should be mobile-responsive, secure, and architected for growth. If you already work with modern stacks such as React, Vue, Node, Django, or similar, that’s great—just outline the approach you prefer along with any database or cloud services you think fit a network of this size. U⁷ Please include: • A brief outline of the tech stack you’d use • Estimated timeline for an MVP that meets the features above • Examples of social or networking products you’ve shipped at scale I’m happy to discuss additional capabilities—like industry browsing or AI-driven connection suggestions—once the essentials are in place, but for now the focus is on profiles, connections, messaging, groups, and robust search.

title: Appointment Setter Needed – Book Qualified Sales Meetings for a Software Development Company -- 2
brief: Zamratech.com is a software development and IT services company with offices in the USA, UK, UAE and Pakistan. We work with startups and established businesses in Finance, Healthcare, eCommerce, Real Estate, SaaS, Travel, Entertainment and Energy. We are hiring an Appointment Setter to book sales meetings with decision-makers who are actively looking to buy one of our services. Services You Will Be Booking Meetings For 1. Web Development – marketing sites, custom portals, SaaS web apps, eCommerce 2. Mobile App Development – iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native 3. Game Development – 2D/3D games in Unity and Unreal 4. AI & LLM Development – AI assistants, chatbots, AI agents, predictive models, computer vision 5. Custom Software – ERP, CRM and internal business tools 6. Cloud & DevOps – CI/CD, Kubernetes, managed cloud hosting 7. Blockchain & NFT – smart contracts, dApps, wallets, NFT marketplaces 8. IoT, AR & VR solutions 9. White Label Applications 10. Digital Marketing – SEO, ASO, social media, Google and Meta ads 11. Maintenance & Support – updates, security, monitoring, fixes (including software built by others) 12. Staff Augmentation / Dedicated Teams – hire React, Node.js, Python, .NET, PHP/Laravel, Flutter, iOS, Android, UI/UX, QA, DevOps, AI/ML, Blockchain and Game developers Your Responsibilities - Find and prospect leads on LinkedIn, email, cold calling, communities, or any other ethical channel you prefer - Qualify every lead before booking - Book meetings ONLY through our official meeting booking link (shared with the selected freelancer after hiring) - Send us a short lead summary for each booked meeting (see below) What Counts as a Qualified Meeting (ALL required) 1. BUSINESS EMAIL – a company domain email ,Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail, Outlook and other free emails are NOT accepted. 2. LINKEDIN PROFILE – a real, active LinkedIn profile of the person, matching their name, job title and company. 3. ACTUAL INQUIRY – the prospect has a real, current project or need for one of the services above (not "just exploring"), and wants to discuss it on the call. - The person is a decision-maker or key influencer (Founder, CEO, CTO, COO, Head of Product, IT Manager, Marketing Head) - The prospect knows the purpose of the call and attends it NOT Counted / NOT Paid - No-shows or meetings that are cancelled and not rescheduled - Free/personal emails or fake/incomplete LinkedIn profiles - Students, job seekers, or other agencies/freelancers selling services - No real project or need - Duplicate leads or leads already in our pipeline - Meetings booked by misleading the prospect Lead Summary Required per Booking Name, job title, company, company website, business email, LinkedIn profile URL, phone (if available), country, service needed, short description of their inquiry/project, expected timeline, and how you found them. Payment - USD 5 per qualified meeting that is attended and meets ALL criteria above - Paid weekly via Freelancer milestones - No limit on meetings: the more qualified meetings you book, the more you earn Requirements - Experience in B2B appointment setting or lead generation, preferably for IT, software or agency services - Good written and spoken English - Basic understanding of tech services (you must be able to explain what we do) To Apply Start your bid with the word "INTENT" so we know you read this post. Then answer: 1. Have you booked meetings for IT/software companies before? Roughly how many? 2. Which channels and industries would you target for Zamra Tech? 3. How do you check that a lead has an actual inquiry before booking? We're looking for a long-term partner. Strong performers will get ongoing work.
